claim_check.reason: The claim states a positive relationship between money supply and interest rates (as one goes down, so does the other). However, Panel a and its caption, 'An increse in the money supply reduces the nominal interes rate,' clearly illustrate an inverse relationship. According to the chart, a decrease in the money supply would lead to an increase in the interest rate, which directly contradicts the claim.
